name: Enrique's Port Wine Braised Beef Short Rib
searchKeywords: enriques port wine braised center cut beef short rib
whyItWorks: Hours of slow braising turn center-cut beef short rib into fork-shredding, gelatinous strands with zero chew resistance.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask to swap the red-skin green-onion mash and long green beans for plain peeled mashed potatoes or steamed white rice so you get 100% of the tender braised beef without potato skins or raw scallions.
watchOuts: Red potato skins and green onions in the default mash
Whole long green beans and crispy fried shallots
